binding_gap: Defence, and specifically the weakest fielded slot — but the gap cannot be closed at the bottom of the market, because nothing affordable beats the man occupying it. The real constraint is not money in the abstract: spending power under the floor rule is many times what we can actually deploy. What binds is that one buy permits exactly one sale, and only a single squad member is large enough to cover a purchase at this level. So the whole budget resolves into one decision about one slot, and the question is only which defender it buys.

verdict.detail: Pull the Pinckert offer, then bid Alphonso Davies before he resolves this morning. The standing Pinckert bid was raised to a premium far above anything this ledger has ever measured as a winning price, and it buys the smallest upgrade of the three defenders now available. Davies is the best defender this ledger has recorded, he is listed at exactly market value, and he resolves earliest — which means contesting him costs nothing that cannot be recovered, because both cheaper fallbacks resolve later. Removing Pinckert first is therefore both the value call and the safety call.
